title: Scalable Bayesian Gaussian Process Classification for Cancer Histopathology: Calibrated Uncertainty Under Distribution Shift
abstract: arXiv:2611.07127v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliable uncertainty quantification is essential for clinical deployment of cancer diagnosis models, yet neural networks and variational Gaussian process methods can produce overconfident predictions, particularly under the distribution shifts that arise when models trained at one hospital are applied at another. We present a scalable Bayesian Gaussian Process Classification (GPC) framework that operates on frozen pathology foundation model embeddings (Phikon) and combines accelerated Randomly Pivoted Cholesky (RPCholesky) for low-rank kernel factorization, Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) with non-centered parameterization for posterior sampling, and a pivots-as-inducing-points scheme for prediction. This makes HMC posterior sampling in the low-rank latent representation tractable at N approximately 300,000 training points, enabling HC-based low-rank GPC on substantially larger datasets than prior MCMC-based demonstrations. translated_title: 面向癌症组织病理学的可扩展贝叶斯高斯过程分类：分布偏移下的校准不确定性
translated_abstract: 可靠的不确定性量化对于癌症诊断模型的临床部署至关重要，然而神经网络和变分高斯过程方法可能产生过度自信的预测，尤其是在模型在一个医院训练后应用于另一个医院时所出现的分布偏移情况下。我们提出了一个可扩展的贝叶斯高斯过程分类（GPC）框架，该框架运行于冻结的病理学基础模型嵌入（Phikon）之上，并结合了用于低秩核分解的加速随机主元Cholesky（RPCholesky）方法、采用非中心化参数化的哈密顿蒙特卡洛（HMC）进行后验采样，以及以主元作为诱导点的预测方案。这使得在训练点数量N约为30万时，低秩潜在表示中的HMC后验采样变得可行，从而使基于HMC的低秩GPC能够应用于比以往基于MCMC的演示大得多的数据集。我们在……上进行评估（原文摘要到此中断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一种可扩展的贝叶斯高斯过程分类框架，通过结合RPCholesky低秩核分解、非中心化参数化HMC后验采样和主元诱导点预测方案，首次在约30万训练点规模上实现可处理的HMC贝叶斯推断，为癌症组织病理学诊断在分布偏移下提供校准的不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: A scalable Bayesian GPC framework combining RPCholesky low-rank kernel factorization, non-centered HMC posterior sampling, and pivots-as-inducing-points prediction enables tractable Bayesian inference on ~300,000 training points, delivering calibrated uncertainty quantification for cancer histopathology under distribution shift.
